about: Edits of the original providers (hospitals, Health Centres, TOMY) applied at startup by utils/setupProviderEdits.js, once per version of this file: renames (matched by Name_GR without accents, case and punctuation), providers to add (skipped when a provider with the same name already exists) fields to set on existing providers (update; new lat/lon -> their place is recomputed) and providers to remove (remove; matched by Name_GR, not removed while linked to a user account). Source: lists 'Μονάδες Υγείας ΕΣΥ ανά Κατηγορία' of the 2nd and 4th ΥΠΕ (October 2026). Hospitals: the list 'Νοσοκομεία ΕΣΥ όλες οι ΥΠΕ' (127, October 2026). Regional clinics (ΠΙ / ΠΠΙ) are named by source_id in update / remove; added ones get a source_id MOH2610-NN. Κ.Υ. / Π.Ι. / Π.Π.Ι.: the Ministry of Health list of Κ.Υ. / Π.Ι. / Π.Π.Ι. (October 2026) (only the certain differences).
